newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Asian Props subsidiary sells hotel stake.
newsitem.headline: Asian Props subsidiary sells hotel stake.

text.p: Asian Properties Ltd said on Monday its wholly owned subsidiary CFE Holdings (Malaysia) had entered a conditional agreement to sell its one-third share of President Hotel Sdn Bhd for RM99 million (about NZ$56.7 million).
Premium Properties, which has a two-thirds interest in President Hotel, is also selling its stake.
The purchaser, Dermajaya Properties, will pay a total cash consideration of RM297 million for all the issued shares in President Hotel.
The sales by Premium and CFE are "interconditional" -- one cannot be completed without the other.
Dermajaya has paid a stakeholder deposit equivalent to 10 percent of the sale price, with the balance to be settled on completion, expected to be by April 1997.
President Hotel is a private company incorporated in Malaysia. It owns the Parkroyal hotels in Kuala Lumpur and Penang. CFE acquired its holding in President in 1989 as a long-term investment.
Asian Properties said the sale price for its stake of NZ$56.7 million was well above the cost of investment.
Completion of the agreement is conditional upon, inter alia, the approval of the Malaysian government and the approval of the shareholders of Asian Properties.
